title: Sound design
description: Music, sound effects and the voiceover mix for every kind of video in the pack: the four-decision sound plan, sourcing a track (the user's file, a connected generator, or by default a CC0 / CC BY track fetched from the web and verified), finding its beat grid, sections and button with ffmpeg and fitting the cuts to it, the level ladder in gain and dB, ducking, fades, SFX placement to the frame, silence as a beat, sparse picture-led films, and measuring and re-mastering the export's loudness. Load it whenever a video has sound.
summary: Free licence-clean music sourcing, beat-grid detection and cutting to it, SFX timing, the VO mix in gain and dB, and loudness checks.

requires.why: A bed or score, generated or found under a licence that allows the use.
Clicks, taps, impacts, chimes and tonal risers placed on exact frames.
Every clip goes on the timeline with frames, gain and fades.
Normalise sources, edit music to length, and measure the export's loudness.
Each cue is checked against the frame its visual event lands on.

models.note: Exact length, instrumental mode, composition plans. Ask for a whole-frame BPM.
Music or SFX up to minutes, flat price per generation.
Describe the sound, not the picture; set a duration; loop for ambience.

triggers: the music is too loud over the voiceover
sync the cuts to the beat
add sound effects to the transitions
mix the audio and fix the loudness
the export sounds quiet or distorted
where do I get music I'm allowed to use
cut the scenes to the beat of the track
